sentences.text: SUNDAR (ORDER) 26.09.2025 [1] Captioned main transfer petition has been presented in this Court under Section 447 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 (BNSS, 2023) with a prayer to transfer Criminal Police Case No. 9 of 2021 (titled State of Manipur Vs. Heisnam Anadjoy Singh) from the file of Chief Judicial Magistrate (CJM), Senapati to either the Court of Chief Judicial Magistrate (CJM), Imphal East or Chief Judicial Magistrate (CJM), Imphal West.

entities.text: State of Manipur Vs. Heisnam Anadjoy Singh
entities.label: PRECEDENT

entities.text: Court of Chief Judicial Magistrate (CJM), Imphal East
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
[2] To be noted,
the complaint is primarily one under Section 498A of erstwhile Indian Penal Code (IPC) and the complainant is transfer petitioner's father-in-law (complainant is R2 before this Court) [3]
Adverting to paragraph 8 of the support petition, learned counsel for transfer petitioner submitted that there is some difficulty in transfer petitioner travelling from Irilbung, Imphal East District to Senapati in Kangpokpi District.
[4] In the light of the contents of the support petition, issue notice.
[5] Mr. Phungyo Zingkhei, learned Dy. Government Advocate, accepts notice for R1, Mr. RK Umakanta, learned senior counsel and Government Advocate, appears on behalf of the State/R1.

[6]
As regards R2, private notice is permitted and learned counsel for transfer petitioner is also permitted to serve on the counsel on record for the complainant in the trial Court.
The next date of listing shall be fortnight hence.
[7] Learned counsel for transfer petitioner submits that the afore- referred criminal case is listed before the Trial Court in Senapati on 06.10.2025 at charge framing stage.

Therefore, there shall be an order of interim stay of all further proceedings in Criminal Police Case No. 9 of 2021 on the file of Chief Judicial Magistrate, Senapati, till next listing List on 10.10.2025.
